skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and necessity of real estate management, purposes of real estate management tasks, contents of real estate management tasks.
Apply knowledge to manage real estate operations safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively.
Analyze and evaluate real estate technically and specifically to develop a concrete real estate management plan.
Demonstrate ethical responsibility, perseverance, professionalism, and cooperation in work.
Develop systematic thinking and information gathering skills.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Adaptability to real estate management situations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop acute thinking skills and adapt to real estate management situations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Planning skills for real estate management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop planning skills in the field of real estate management.
Develop independent work capability and teamwork when participating in professional activities.
Express and defend personal views based on an objective and scientific approach.
Identify and fulfill social and professional ethical responsibilities when making judgments and evaluations in the field of real estate management.
